dogecoin.text: And also, you can top up your wallet on Dogechain with some #Dogechain-based $DOGE when performing a bridging transaction to enable you to have gas fees to interact on the chain.
Instead of bridging $DOGE via the Dogechain Native Bridge, you can use Router to get these blue-chip assets to buy DOG20 tokens from @QuickswapDEX.
